body:
Way too much ads. Extremely annoying. Especially first thing in the morning.

Pro plan not worth the price at all imo. Maybe if it was like $3/yr.

The UI is also not great and the Korean language leaks into the UI sometimes.

They also introduced some gamification features but it’s also pretty annoying to me and poorly thought out.

They try to be nice to all religions but I find it offensive. They should just not include religious sounds on the app, and let users add their own sounds if they want without including it on their own.

It used to be decent but now it’s really not worth it anymore with the amount of ads on here and overpriced pro plan.

The alarm sounds are okay, and definitely will wake you up.

But most times, even after completing their missions, I end up turning it off and going back to sleep.

Regardless, it is definitely a better alarm app than most.

But I think they’ve gotten lazy. It could definitely be better imo.

Maybe I should get a real alarm clock instead. I heard they are better.

body: I don’t normally write reviews, but I feel like this deserves it. Alarmy has a feature that has been making my life so much easier, it allows you to make little missions to complete before the alarm goes off. They have puzzles, physical things, and phrase writing. For example, my alarm goes off, I do 3 memory puzzles, then 3 math problems, then I write 3 phrases, then I shake my phone 30 times, then I scan the barcode to my medication which is across my house. There’s absolutely no way to stay asleep after all that! And it tracks your sleep, plays calming music, and records your snoring (which I always find very very amusing since I don’t snore much). I genuinely recommend this app!

title: Alarm With Everything
body:
I am 53 years old and this has got to be the best alarm clock app I have found, second to none besides our old fashioned clocks we put on the other side of the room to make us get up before we threw it out the window. 

The design team has thought of just about everything that could be done to avoid getting up and they keep adding more. There is now a wake up call (not just snooze but it checks to see you’re up). There are so many options for missions (I found out I can’t type with one eye open especially three full sentences but I was up after it). The alarms are horribly loud and annoying. Snooze options, missions to complete to turn it off (such as shake the phone 30 times), wake up checks, and now there is even a mode that will make you pay if you cheat the alarm. 

There are bedtime reminders, sleep sounds, analyze your sleep and snoring, horoscopes, weather, mood trackers and even a few you can charge yourself if you tend to try to cheat. So much more is included and it’s a well developed app and the best alarm I’ve ever had. 

Thank you Alarmy team. Sleep and wake time are critical in mood, thinking, overall physical feeling. Maybe next could me some about how much sleep does one need since I have heard different people require different amounts and that if you’re woken up at certain points of the sleep cycle you can completely change how you feel when you get up as well as your day. 

Anyway I rarely write reviews but this one deserves extra recognition. Keep going strong Team. You’ve nailed it in my eyes!

I have my phone set to “vibrate” but the alarm sound is still supposed to play, and did the other days and the past weeks I’ve been using this app. 
The other thing that occurred when this bug happened is each time the phone vibrated, “Alarmy” popped up as a new notification (so I had a chain of 30, 40, 50 etc) instead of just one notification with the “wake up” message which is what usually happens. title: Wakey wakey.....

It's hard to get out of bed sometimes.... but then there are those OTHER times, when you've got a small rectangular light-box buzzing at you, that won't stop until you snap a pic of the sink where you wash your face...

And then, when you think you're good and maybe you can lie down again for one more minute, you get zapped with another fit from your phone... commanding you with its mind-powers to take a click of the chair in your office, from the exact spot where you do your morning exercise... and now that you're standing there, feeling like you want to go back to bed, but realizing that it would be the biggest walk of shame you might experience in life, it dawns on you... that THIS IS... one of those OTHER times... where it wasn't that hard to get out of bed.

And that's the story of why Alarmy is awesome. The end.

-aaron-
